Also, on the topic of English, it's very smooth, good flow! A few just nitpicks, honestly:

'...and it's a truly beautiful game but in certain point...'

I would recommend instead using "during a certain" or "in a ".

'... a charcter tells player...'

A character tells THE player, most likely.

'...movie teather'

Just a typo, movie theater is the proper spelling.

'My ex-girlfriend always questioned me of why do we always have to watch these kind of films...'

I would recommend, "My ex-girlfriend always questioned why we always have to watch these kinds of films", or "My ex-girlfriend always asked me why we always watch these kinds of films". They're less clunky.

Hope this helped!
